title: Bill Watrous Someplace Else CD 1986 Soundwings Jazz Trombone Live Digital
conditionDescription: Pre-owned. Disc, jewel case and inserts show normal light wear consistent with age and storage. Please review photos for exact condition.
descriptionText:
Bill Watrous - Someplace Else, with Patrick Williams and his Orchestra
(Soundwings SWD-2100, 1986). UPC 014922210027. A live digital recording,
digitally recorded and digitally mastered. DDD. Produced by
Patrick Williams; recorded and mixed by Armin Steiner at
Twentieth Century-Fox in Los Angeles.

Featuring Randy Kerber, keyboards; Tim May, guitar;
Neil Stubenhaus, bass; Harvey Mason, drums; Stuart Canin,
concertmaster.

1. La Fuerza (5:27)
2. Come Rain Or Come Shine (5:17)
3. No More Blues (3:06)
4. Shenandoah (3:53)
5. There Is No Greater Love (6:06)
6. Suite Memories (9:05)
7. Adieu Mon Petite Table (2:10)
8. A Tribute To Debussy (9:38)

Disc, jewel case and pictured inserts are included. You will receive the exact CD pictured.
